ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (StoneArmor.cs:22-25) == cost 1 / POWER / UNCOMMON / SELF. It does NOT override GainsBlock even though PlatingPower grants block each turn, and the sim correctly leaves `gains_block` False -- the same distinction card/eternal_armor and card/feel_no_pain draw.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<PlatingPower>(4m)` (StoneArmor.cs:14) == `_plating = 4`, stored in the `_plating` slot `magic_number` reads -- the same correct storage card/eternal_armor uses for the same power, and the counterpart to card/feel_no_pain's mistake of putting a power amount in `_block`.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<PlatingPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["PlatingPower"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (StoneArmor.cs:29) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, PlatingPower, self._plating, applier=ctx.player)`. Same power and same shape as card/eternal_armor, so the two cards are consistent on both sides. Presentation, folded in: two hover tips (16-20).
